entities.summary: Nanda, a notable figure in the history of India, associated with Vedic Period and Mahajanapadas (600 BCE–321 BCE). Preceded by Early and Later Vedic Period. Their legacy influenced Gautama Buddha attains enlightenment and begins teaching the Dharma and Alexander the Great invades the Punjab and defeats King Porus at the Hydaspes.
